run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T03:03:32Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: frontend-proxy's RequestErrorRate alert reflects real error spans on its ingress and 'router frontend egress' operations. Two error components are visible in the evidence. (a) A low-rate, pre-existing component: frontend-proxy returned 503 with response flags 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' toward the frontend upstream from ~02:47 onward (0.0037-0.0148 errored spans/s, i.e. roughly 1.5% of ingress span rate), and this is what was present when the alert started at 03:03:32. (b) The dominant component: the ad Deployment was rolled out at 03:04:52 (old pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc deleted, new pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh created 03:04:52, container started 03:04:54). The ad Deployment has no readinessProbe/livenessProbe/startupProbe, so the new pod became a ready Service endpoint immediately while the Java process only logged 'Ad service starting.' at 03:09:41.9 and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 03:11:37.2. During that gap, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans failed with gRPC 14 'No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080', frontend's GET /api/data returned HTTP 500, and frontend-proxy ingress returned 500, driving ingress errors to a peak of ~1.04 errored spans/s (03:10:32) before decaying back to the ~0.01-0.02/s baseline by 03:18:32. Cart, checkout, product-catalog and recommendation calls from frontend showed zero error rate at the peak, so the failure was limited to the ads path; the ad container recovered without a restart once its process began listening.

claims.text: At 2026-11-15T03:03:32Z frontend-proxy span error rate was: operation 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.0148/s, operation 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0/s, while 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_UNSET (non-error) was 12.65/s — i.e. ~0.1% of its own spans errored at the moment the alert started.

frontend-proxy error-span rate (5m) over 02:43:32-03:22:32: 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 0 until 02:46:32, then 0.0037-0.0148/s from 02:47:32 to 03:05:32, jumped at 03:06:32 (0.211), peaked at 1.037/s at 03:10:32 (1.022 at 03:11:32), and returned to 0.0148-0.0209/s by 03:18:32-03:22:32; 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR was exactly 0 until 03:05:32, peaked 1.011/s at 03:10:32, and was 0 again from 03:18:32.

At 03:12:32 the only services with any error spans were frontend-proxy ('ingress' 0.769/s, 'router frontend egress' 0.761/s) and frontend: 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' ERROR 0.761/s, 'GET /api/data' ERROR 0.993/s, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' ERROR 0.993/s, 'GET' ERROR 0.993/s, 'tcp.connect' ERROR 0.0148/s. In the same reading frontend's calls to cart, checkout, product-catalog and recommendation had 0 error rate.

The error text on frontend's 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' spans is gRPC status 14 with message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080'; the parent 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' span logs the same exception and returns HTTP 500, and the enclosing frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' spans are HTTP 500 (observed at ~03:05:28, 03:06:24-03:12:00).

ad Deployment was rolled out at 03:04:52-03:04:54: ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 'SuccessfulCreate' created pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh (Scheduled 03:04:52, container Created 03:04:53, Started 03:04:54, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) while ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 'SuccessfulDelete' deleted pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc (Killing / Stopping container ad 03:04:54).

Pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh (started 03:04:52, Running/Ready, restartCount 0, no previous container instance) logged 'Ad service starting.' at 2026-11-15T03:09:41.907Z and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 2026-11-15T03:11:37.208Z — about 4.8 and 6.7 minutes after its container started, with no error/exception lines matching a start|listening|error|exception|warn filter.

The ad Deployment (1 replica, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, containerPort 8080, no readinessProbe, no livenessProbe, no startupProbe) reports 1 ready/available replica, and Service 'ad' currently has exactly one ready endpoint, 100.96.3.224 -> pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh.

ad service span activity stopped on the ad side during the same interval: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="ad"}[5m])) fell from ~1.7-2.0/s at 03:05:32 to 0 at 03:10:32-03:13:32 and recovered to 0.607 at 03:14:32; GetAds rate at 15s resolution was 0 from 03:08:32 through 03:13:32 and 1.7-1.9/s from 03:14:32. At 03:12:32 every ad series ('oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', getRandomAds, resolve, flagd ResolveBoolean) read 0.

Most likely mechanism for the large error wave: because the ad Deployment defines no readiness/startup probe, the replacement pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh was counted Ready as soon as its container started (03:04:54) and the old serving pod was deleted at 03:04:54, so the 'ad' Service routed frontend traffic to a pod whose application was not yet listening on 8080. Frontend's GetAds then got ECONNREFUSED (100.70.197.56:8080), frontend returned HTTP 500 on /api/data, and frontend-proxy ingress recorded 500s until the ad process started listening (~03:11:37, ad spans and frontend-proxy error rate back to baseline ~03:13-03:18).

Second, separate candidate and the one temporally closest to the alert's start time: before the ad rollout, frontend-proxy already logged 503 responses with flags 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' toward the frontend upstream (observed 02:56:21, 02:57:36, 02:58:56, 02:59:12, 03:02:10, 03:02:26, 03:03:53, 03:05:34, 03:05:50), which kept ingress error rate nonzero (~0.4-1.5% of ingress span rate) when the alert started at 03:03:32, 80 s before the ad pod was replaced (03:04:52). Its originating cause is unresolved.

The 503s of that earlier component are upstream connection terminations, not application responses: full trace bdcea1642793cc55bae91f4e6a20d721 (02:58:56) contains only load-generator spans ('user_index', 'GET' -> 503) and frontend-proxy spans ('ingress' 503, 'router frontend egress' error=true http.status_code=0, 533 ms) and contains no frontend span, matching envoy's log line '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}'.

Rejected as a cause of this alert: the fraud-detection pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-zzt65 shows lastState.terminated OOMKilled with exit code 137 and restartCount 1, and its container 'Started' again at 03:11:43 inside the window — but the checkout path it belongs to shows no failure: at 03:12:32 frontend's 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' error rate was 0 and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' / 'POST /api/checkout' error rates were 0, so it is a coincident change, not the source of frontend-proxy ingress errors.

Rejected: the ad service itself erroring or crash-looping after the rollout. After it began listening it served normally (GetAds 1.7-1.9/s from 03:14:32, ~1.6-2.0/s at 5m resolution through 03:22:32), its container restarted 0 times with no previous instance, and its own spans carried STATUS_CODE_UNSET (no ad-side error spans were recorded).

Scope check of the blast radius: at 03:12:32 no error spans existed for any service other than frontend and frontend-proxy, and frontend's client spans to cart (GetCart/AddItem), checkout (PlaceOrder), product-catalog (GetProduct) and recommendation (ListRecommendations) all had 0 error rate — the errors were confined to the ads-dependent /api/data path.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be read: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no_data (no rules returned), so the rule expression, window and threshold that produced the annotation value 'current: 2.4555555555555553' are unverified; the observed frontend-proxy error ratio was ~0.12% of its ingress span rate at 03:03:32 and ~6% at 03:10:32, so the annotation value cannot be reconciled with the metric I could query.

http_server_request_duration_seconds_count had no series in the query window (get_all_labels returned no_data), so that candidate source of a 'request error rate' metric could not be examined; ERROR-status series that were never returned are unknown, not zero.

The change_history integration is not available in this run, so why the ad Deployment was rolled out at 03:04:52 (and whether the change was configuration-only or a restart of the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) is unknown.

The origin of the intermittent frontend-proxy 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' responses toward the frontend upstream (present from ~02:47 through at least 03:05) is not determined; frontend application logs for 02:45-03:05 were not read, so whether the frontend process closed those connections is unknown.
Logs of the deleted old ad pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc are unavailable, so its shutdown behaviour (graceful drain vs immediate termination) cannot be verified.
Trace-derived metrics in this data source end at 03:22:32 (last returned point), so frontend-proxy error behaviour after that instant, including whether the alert resolved, is unknown.
next_steps: Add a readinessProbe (and ideally a startupProbe) on port 8080 to the ad containers in the otel-demo ad Deployment so a replacement pod is only added to the 'ad' Service endpoint set once the JVM is listening; this would have prevented the ECONNREFUSED window between 03:04:54 and ~03:11:37.

Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the alerting/rule source and confirm which metric, ratio and window produce the reported value 2.4555555555555553, to reconcile it with the observed frontend-proxy error span rates.

Inspect the frontend application logs and its keep-alive/timeout settings for the period 02:45-03:05 to explain the intermittent 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' 503s that preceded the ad outage.
Check the change-management record for the otel-demo ad Deployment change at 03:04:52 (and the fraud-detection OOM restart at ~03:11:42) once change history is available.
